comment: One source of truth for how a document name becomes a library slug. Both languages must satisfy every case: plugins/revit (C# ModelLibrary.Slugify) and plugins/ingetrazo (Python slugify). Checked by tools/addincheck and tools/ingetrazo/test_library.py.

cases.why: spaces and punctuation become single dashes
non-ASCII punctuation is a separator, not a letter
an empty name still needs a folder

cases.input: Casa en los Arboles Rehabilitacion Integral Fase Tres Edificio Norte
